description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dambana, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad Map No. 710064 (24/0536)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding ownership of multiple land parcels. The content includes detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and nature of title. It falls under PART III - LANDS and is made under the Registration of Title Act, making it clearly a land-related gazette according to Type 4 criteria.
